description: Fixed isolated frontend QA operations; no arbitrary command or production credentials.

linux.commands:
/bin/sh -lc 'set -eu
curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz >/dev/null
curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null
format=$(printf '"'"'\173\173.Config.Image\175\175'"'"')
image=$(timeout --kill-after=5s 15s docker inspect -f "$format" academy-api)
exec timeout --kill-after=5s 210s docker exec -i -e QA_CAPABILITY='"'"'{{ OwnershipCapability }}'"'"' -e QA_ACTION='"'"'{{ Action }}'"'"' -e QA_TENANT='"'"'{{ TenantCode }}'"'"' -e QA_TENANT_ID={{TenantId}} -e QA_RELEASE='"'"'{{ ReleaseId }}'"'"' -e QA_DIGEST='"'"'{{ ApiDigest }}'"'"' -e QA_IMAGE="$image" -e QA_SYNTHETIC_LONG_VIDEO={{ SyntheticLongVideo }} academy-api python - <<'"'"'ACADEMY_QA_PY'"'"'
import hashlib, hmac, io, json, os, re, signal, sys
import boto3, django
from contextlib import redirect_stdout, redirect_stderr
from botocore.config import Config

def ownership_payload(tenant, tenant_id, capability):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", capability):
        raise PermissionError("Invalid ownership capability")
    return {"schema": "frontend-development-qa/v1", "tenant_code": tenant,
            "tenant_id": tenant_id, "owner_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                (tenant + ":" + str(tenant_id) + ":" + capability).encode()).hexdigest()}

def assert_cleanup_owner(tenant, tenant_id, capability, records):
    expected = ownership_payload(tenant, tenant_id, capability)
    if len(records) != 1 or not isinstance(records[0], dict):
        raise PermissionError("Missing or ambiguous QA creation ownership")
    record = records[0]
    if (set(record) != set(expected)
            or any(record[key] != expected[key] for key in ("schema", "tenant_code", "tenant_id"))
            or not isinstance(record["owner_sha256"], str)
            or not hmac.compare_digest(record["owner_sha256"], expected["owner_sha256"])):
        raise PermissionError("QA cleanup ownership mismatch")

def operation_timeout(_signum, _frame):
    raise TimeoutError("Fixed QA operation deadline exceeded")

def expected_video_state(enabled):
    return {"active_playback_sessions": 0, "playback_events": 0, "playback_sessions": 0,
            "player_errors": 0, "proctored_video_accesses": 2 if enabled else 0,
            "video_accesses": 2 if enabled else 0, "video_progresses": 0,
            "videos": 1 if enabled else 0, "violated_events": 0}

def empty_residue():
    return {"activity_audits": 0, "outstanding_tokens": 0, "listeners": 0,
            "processes": 0, "r2_objects": 0}

def failure_payload(error, context):
    allowed_stages = {"bootstrap", "identity", "inspect_database", "inspect_residue",
                      "setup_database", "setup_readback", "cleanup_identity",
                      "cleanup_absent_readback", "cleanup_r2", "cleanup_database",
                      "cleanup_readback"}
    stage = context.get("stage")
    if stage not in allowed_stages:
        stage = "unknown"
    residue = empty_residue()
    supplied_residue = context.get("residue")
    if isinstance(supplied_residue, dict):
        for key in residue:
            value = supplied_residue.get(key)
            if type(value) is int and value >= 0:
                residue[key] = value
    tenant_id = context.get("tenant_id")
    if type(tenant_id) is not int or tenant_id <= 0:
        tenant_id = 0
    return {"status": "DEVELOPMENT_QA_FAILED", "error_type": type(error).__name__,
            "failure_stage": stage, "tenant_id": tenant_id, "residue": residue}

def run(failure_context=None):
    if not isinstance(failure_context, dict):
        failure_context = {}
    failure_context.update({"stage": "identity", "residue": empty_residue()})
    failure_context.setdefault("tenant_id", 0)
    action = os.environ["QA_ACTION"]
    capability = os.environ["QA_CAPABILITY"]
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", capability)
    tenant = os.environ["QA_TENANT"]
    tenant_id_value = os.environ["QA_TENANT_ID"]
    assert re.fullmatch(r"(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})", tenant_id_value)
    expected_tenant_id = int(tenant_id_value)
    assert expected_tenant_id <= 9223372036854775807
    failure_context["tenant_id"] = expected_tenant_id
    release = os.environ["QA_RELEASE"]
    digest = os.environ["QA_DIGEST"]
    synthetic_long_video_value = os.environ["QA_SYNTHETIC_LONG_VIDEO"]
    assert synthetic_long_video_value in {"false", "true"}
    synthetic_long_video = synthetic_long_video_value == "true"
    assert action in {"Inspect", "Setup", "Cleanup"}
    if action == "Setup":
        assert expected_tenant_id == 0
    if action == "Cleanup":
        assert expected_tenant_id > 0
    assert re.fullmatch(r"qa-ymath-realuse-fe-[0-9]+-[0-9]+-[a-f0-9]{12}", tenant)
    assert re.fullmatch(r"sha-[a-f0-9]{40}-run-[0-9]+-[0-9]+", release)
    assert re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}", digest)
    assert os.environ["DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE"] == "apps.api.config.settings.development"
    assert os.environ["ACADEMY_RUNTIME_ENV"] == "development"
    assert os.environ["ACADEMY_DEVELOPMENT_RELEASE_ID"] == release
    assert os.environ["QA_IMAGE"] == "809466760795.dkr.ecr.ap-northeast-2.amazonaws.com/academy-api@" + digest
    assert os.environ.get("SOLAPI_MOCK", "").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes"}
    assert os.environ.get("TOSS_AUTO_BILLING_ENABLED", "").lower() not in {"1", "true", "yes"}
    django.setup()
    from django.conf import settings
    from django.core.management import call_command
    from django.db import connection, transaction
    from apps.core.models import OpsAuditLog
    from apps.core.management.commands.setup_ymath_realuse_scenario import Command, assert_isolated_runtime
    assert not settings.VIDEO_BATCH_JOB_QUEUE and not settings.VIDEO_BATCH_JOB_DEFINITION
    for key in ("AI_SQS_QUEUE_NAME_LITE", "AI_SQS_QUEUE_NAME_BASIC", "AI_SQS_QUEUE_NAME_PREMIUM"):
        assert os.environ[key] == "academy-v1-development-ai-queue"
    assert settings.TOOLS_SQS_QUEUE_NAME == "academy-v1-development-tools-queue"
    assert settings.MESSAGING_SQS_QUEUE_NAME == "academy-v1-development-messaging-queue"
    assert settings.DATABASES["default"]["NAME"] == "academy_api_development"
    assert settings.DATABASES["default"]["USER"] == "academy_api_development_app"
    assert all(getattr(settings, key) == "academy-development-artifacts" for key in
               ("R2_AI_BUCKET", "R2_STORAGE_BUCKET", "R2_ADMIN_BUCKET", "R2_VIDEO_BUCKET", "R2_EXCEL_BUCKET"))
    assert_isolated_runtime()
    command = Command()
    remaining = command._remaining_for_code(tenant)
    video_state = command._video_residue_for_code(tenant)
    if action == "Inspect":
        assert remaining["tenants"] in {0, 1}
        residue = empty_residue()
        tenant_id = expected_tenant_id or None
        r2_scope_proven = expected_tenant_id > 0
        if remaining["tenants"] == 1:
            failure_context["stage"] = "inspect_database"
            with transaction.atomic():
                existing = command._exact_tenant_or_fail_on_case_variant(tenant)
                assert existing is not None
                if expected_tenant_id:
                    assert existing.pk == expected_tenant_id
                tenant_id = existing.pk
                r2_scope_proven = True
                failure_context["tenant_id"] = tenant_id
                residue.update(command._owned_database_residue(existing))
        failure_context["stage"] = "inspect_residue"
        residue.update(command._non_database_residue(tenant_id=tenant_id, tenant_code=tenant))
        failure_context["residue"] = residue.copy()
        return {"status": "DEVELOPMENT_QA_IDENTITY_PASS", "tenant_code": tenant,
                "tenant_id": tenant_id or 0, "r2_scope_proven": r2_scope_proven,
                "release_id": release, "digest": digest, "remaining": remaining,
                "residue": residue, "video_state": video_state}
    output = io.StringIO()
    subject = None
    subject_id = None
    r2_cleanup = None
    with transaction.atomic():
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("SET LOCAL statement_timeout = 150000")
            cursor.execute("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = 5000")
        command._lock_tenant_code(tenant)
        existing = command._exact_tenant_or_fail_on_case_variant(tenant)
        if action == "Setup":
            failure_context["stage"] = "setup_database"
            assert existing is None
            assert command._remaining_for_code(tenant) == {"tenants": 0, "users": 0}
            secret = boto3.client("ssm", region_name="ap-northeast-2",
                                  config=Config(connect_timeout=10, read_timeout=10,
                                                retries={"total_max_attempts": 2})).get_parameter(
                Name="/academy/api/development/ymath-realuse-password", WithDecryption=True)
            os.environ["YMATH_REALUSE_SCENARIO_PASSWORD"] = secret["Parameter"]["Value"]
            try:
                call_command("setup_ymath_realuse_scenario", tenant_code=tenant,
                             student_count=2 if synthetic_long_video else 1, session_count=1,
                             synthetic_long_video=synthetic_long_video, stdout=output)
                created = command._exact_tenant_or_fail_on_case_variant(tenant)
                assert created is not None
                subject = created
                subject_id = created.pk
                OpsAuditLog.objects.create(
                    action="development.qa.setup", target_tenant=created,
                    actor_username="frontend-release-runner",
                    payload=ownership_payload(tenant, created.pk, capability), result="success")
            finally:
                os.environ.pop("YMATH_REALUSE_SCENARIO_PASSWORD", None)
        else:
            failure_context["stage"] = "cleanup_identity"
            if existing is None:
                assert command._remaining_for_code(tenant) == {"tenants": 0, "users": 0}
                failure_context["stage"] = "cleanup_absent_readback"
                residue = empty_residue()
                residue.update(command._non_database_residue(
                    tenant_id=expected_tenant_id, tenant_code=tenant))
                failure_context["residue"] = residue.copy()
                assert residue == empty_residue()
                video_residue = command._video_residue_for_code(tenant)
                assert video_residue == expected_video_state(False)
                return {"status": "YMATH_REALUSE_SCENARIO_ABSENT", "tenant_code": tenant,
                        "tenant_id": expected_tenant_id, "r2_scope_proven": True,
                        "remaining": {"tenants": 0, "users": 0}, "residue": residue,
                        "video_residue": video_residue}
            assert existing.pk == expected_tenant_id
            records = list(OpsAuditLog.objects.filter(
                action="development.qa.setup", target_tenant=existing, result="success"
            ).values_list("payload", flat=True)[:2])
            assert_cleanup_owner(tenant, existing.pk, capability, records)
            subject_id = existing.pk
            failure_context["stage"] = "cleanup_r2"
            residue = empty_residue()
            residue.update(command._non_database_residue(
                tenant_id=subject_id, tenant_code=tenant))
            failure_context["residue"] = residue.copy()
            r2_cleanup = command._cleanup_qa_r2_objects(tenant_id=subject_id)
            assert set(r2_cleanup) == {"deleted", "remaining"}
            assert all(type(value) is int and value >= 0 for value in r2_cleanup.values())
            assert r2_cleanup["remaining"] == 0
            residue.update(command._non_database_residue(
                tenant_id=subject_id, tenant_code=tenant))
            failure_context["residue"] = residue.copy()
            assert residue["r2_objects"] == 0
            failure_context["stage"] = "cleanup_database"
            call_command("setup_ymath_realuse_scenario", tenant_code=tenant,
                         destroy=True, stdout=output)
    payload = json.loads(output.getvalue().strip().splitlines()[-1])
    assert payload["tenant_code"] == tenant
    if action == "Setup":
        failure_context["stage"] = "setup_readback"
        assert payload["tenant_id"] == subject_id
        payload["residue"] = command._owned_database_residue(subject)
        assert payload["video_state"] == expected_video_state(synthetic_long_video)
        if synthetic_long_video:
            assert payload["synthetic_long_video"]["hls_path"] == "qa-fixtures/video-long/master.m3u8"
            assert payload["synthetic_long_video"]["duration_seconds"] == 900
            assert payload["synthetic_long_video"]["video_accesses"] == 2
        else:
            assert "synthetic_long_video" not in payload
    else:
        failure_context["stage"] = "cleanup_readback"
        assert payload["tenant_id"] == expected_tenant_id
        assert payload["residue"] == {"activity_audits": 0, "outstanding_tokens": 0}
        assert payload["video_residue"] == expected_video_state(False)
        payload["r2_cleanup"] = r2_cleanup
    payload["residue"].update(command._non_database_residue(
        tenant_id=subject_id, tenant_code=tenant))
    failure_context["residue"] = payload["residue"].copy()
    assert payload["residue"] == empty_residue()
    payload["tenant_id"] = subject_id
    payload["r2_scope_proven"] = True
    if action == "Cleanup":
        assert payload["remaining"] == {"tenants": 0, "users": 0}
        assert payload["video_residue"] == expected_video_state(False)
    return payload

failure_context = {"stage": "bootstrap", "tenant_id": 0, "residue": empty_residue()}
try:
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, operation_timeout)
    signal.alarm(180)
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()), redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
        result = run(failure_context)
    signal.alarm(0)
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
except Exception as error:
    print(json.dumps(failure_payload(error, failure_context), sort_keys=True))
    sys.exit(1)

ACADEMY_QA_PY'
